thread:
viv (PM): Quick sync on compliance panel UX. Main gaps: retention label, residency wording, and encryption badge naming. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mnop3456/compliance-panel. PTAL.

noah (Designer): pushed compact mock. Two options: label = 'Region' or 'Data residency' (longer). Also debating 'Customer-managed key (CMEK)' vs 'Customer key (BYOK)'.

figma-bot: noah updated 'Compliance panel / compact' 4dd 1774001188

rachel (Security): Prefer 'Customer-managed key (CMEK)' in copy; BYOK is ambiguous. Also we should avoid showing raw vendor acronyms like 'KMS' without explanation. Add small compatibility hint when a key is selected.

jon (Eng): tech notes: 'Permanent' vs 'Indefinite' retention maps to manual_delete flag. Fine but require a confirmation modal. For key checks we can call a compatibility API and show a small warning badge: 'CMEK may be region-restricted'.

anya (Accessibility): a11y nits: encryption badge contrast too low; make text darker or add outline. Region dropdown needs a visible 2px focus ring and aria-describedby for the help text. When retention is set to 'Permanent', fire an aria-live polite announcement: 'Retention set to Permanent: data will not be auto-deleted.'

noah (Designer): proposed strings: 'Data retention' label; options '30 days', '90 days', 'Permanent'; residency label keep 'Region' + help text 'Data residency: where data is stored physically'; encryption: 'Encryption: Redwood-managed' / 'Encryption: Customer-managed (CMEK)'; audit CTA: 'Download audit log'.

viv (PM): Quick decisions: use 'Region' short label with help text for legal, use 'Customer-managed key (CMEK)' per security, make retention option 'Permanent' visually but include SR-only expansion 'Permanent   data retained until manually deleted'. Action items: noah adjust contrast & focus; jon wire confirmation + compat check; rachel draft tooltip copy; anya provide 5-point a11y checklist. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
